# Tips for Fallout 76 beginners and beginners

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_4_nukaknights-post-tipps-fuer-einsteiger.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## Basics

- 
All items, tools, skill cards, mutations and armor create an overall picture of how “strong” your character is in the game
- 
It is not enough to have a specific weapon to survive against all opponents.
- 
You can find all information about your weapons, armor, tools, quests, etc. in your **PipBoy**.
- 
Place items and tools that you often use on the "**quick wheel**" so that you don't have to search for them in the PipBoy when things have to be done quickly.
- 
Make sure you have enough ammo, stimpacks, (water and food). 
(Hunger and thirst no longer have negative effects, so this is now a minor matter.)
- 
When you select a quest in PipBoy, there is an option at the bottom that allows you to switch to the next **task of the quest on the map**. This makes it easier for you to find your next destination on the map.
- 
Your **stash box** can hold everything that you don't want to or can't carry on your husband/woman and can hold **max. 1200**.
- 
You can access your stash box **from anywhere**. Both in other CAMPs as well as at train stations, in survival tents and anywhere else you see stash boxes. A stash box in another CAMP is not someone else's box, but always your own. The same applies to the scrap box (infinite scrap box from Fallout 1st).
- 
Try to plan a **skill set** right at the beginning so that you don't "wrongly" select cards when you level up that you don't want to use at all. There are various tools for planning (it's best to decide whether you want to play automatic rifles, single-shot rifles, heavy weapons, melee combat, shotguns, pistols, with/without power armor, full life / bloodstained / junkie). For further build/char ideas you can create up to 5 characters.
 - Build planner can be found e.g. here:
 https://www.vault76.de/fo76/planer/ or
 https://nukesdragons.com/fallout76/perks
 - You can find examples of skillsets/builds under the topic “Builds”: https://nukaknights.com/blog/builds/
 - You can change your skill tree via**loadouts** and train stations or in your camp. There are 2 free skill loadouts, and up to 11 can be purchased in the Atom Shop.
- 
You can access your **skill cards** via the PipBoy, e.g. on the Xbox using the Y key/T key on the PC when the PipBoy is open.
- 
**Atom Shop**: All purchased items (except repair kits) are available for use on all characters at the workbenches or in the CAMP.
- 
Try to collect your Atom daily and weekly through the **Challenges**, then you can earn lots of things from the Atom Shop for free.
- 
By **sleeping** (approx. 30 seconds) you will receive a +5% XP (experience points) bonus for 2 hours.
- 
By playing an **instrument** (approx. 30 seconds) you receive an AP (action points) bonus.
- 
**Action Points** (AP) are required for sprinting and VATS
- 
Keep an eye on your **weight**, if you are overloaded you will not be able to travel fast and will be immobile.
 - Disassemble scrap as often as possible and then store it
 - Disassemble and store weapons and armor that you don't need
 - Gunpowder is difficult to store or process
 - When not playing, regularly throw away 40mm grenades, mini nukes, fuel, cannonballs, rockets and other heavy ammunition.
 - Sell excess food and chems to the bots at the train stations to save weight and earn bottle caps.
